pages.article_html:
Griffon Riders of Antiquity

Level 38 · Adventuring · Wardship Of The Sleeping Moon · Thestra

Fight into Thelaseen, which once served as the griffon eyrie of the Celestine Ward, but is now known as the lair of the drake riders. Find Aluve Helesanth, a spectral griffon rider, and speak with him.

Description

Ainsley says, "The Celestine Ward of the past, being more rigid in its ways, chose not to recover its main eyrie after the cataclysm destroyed it." "If you can fight your way past the drake riders who have claimed the ancient griffon roost of Thelaseen , look for Aluve Helesanth . He was slain in the aftermath of the cataclysm , and he has many secrets to divulge."

What they say

On offering it

Ainsley
The Celestine Ward of the past, being more rigid in its ways, chose not to recover its main eyrie after the cataclysm destroyed it. If you can fight your way past the drake riders who have claimed the ancient griffon roost of Thelaseen , look for Aluve Helesanth . He was slain in the aftermath of the cataclysm , and he has many secrets to divulge.

Recorded by quest description.

Notes

Aluve Helesanth is located on the back (east end) of the central platform.

2 recorded disagreements about this quest — level (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80), starts npc (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80).

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

findings.observation: Summary instructs fighting into Thelaseen and speaking with spectral griffon rider Aluve Helesanth. No kill count, item counter or parley mechanics is printed; fight-through narrative does not establish a kill objective.

Header prints level 38; two recorded disagreements concern level and starts npc, attributed to wiki.silkyvenom.com:80. The page does not print the alternative values. Port 80 is part of attribution, not a quest level. Historical level and disputed starter remain unresolved.
Starts with and offering dialogue identify Ainsley; Also involved lists Ainsley Heath. Retain literal names without resolving their identity from name similarity. Hand-in identifies Aluve Helesanth.
Notes locate Aluve Helesanth on the back (east end) of the central platform. This is descriptive relative geography, not an exact spawn or numerical coordinate.

Offering dialogue attributes to Ainsley the account that the Celestine Ward did not recover its main eyrie after the cataclysm, drake riders claimed Thelaseen, and Aluve was slain after the cataclysm. Preserve as attributed historical narrative rather than independently verified world chronology.

Details print Celestine Ward +300 and Order of the True Blood -300. Rewards say Archetype-specific waist armor without item links or archetype mapping. No item identity, armor stats, currency amount or XP is established.

Chain is Thelaseen Weapon; Next links Recover our History. These are navigation relationships, not verified enforced prerequisites. The second summary retains crawler link-address annotations rather than supplying independent corroboration.

Source links thetelonproject.wikidot.com; disagreement attribution names wiki.silkyvenom.com:80. No original source was fetched in this offline review, and mirrored accounts are not independent verification.
